status: Integrated development source and verified scoped tablet deployment; not published to production.
scope: PDF and EPUB links/attachments imported into native My files. No general-purpose invisible Downloads directory, website saving, system daemon or unsafe XOVI autostart.
protections: Confirmation and Cancel before downloading; cancellation on Web unload, including cancellation arriving before process startup.
Binary files stream to private disk, never a QML responseText string. File bytes are capped independently of advertised Content-Length.
PDF header/EOF or EPUB ZIP structure, mimetype and expanded-size checks before native import. Structural validation is not a malware guarantee.
Public IPv4 HTTPS port 443 only; resolved socket addresses and every redirect checked, private/local/metadata destinations blocked; system TLS checks on and environment proxies off.
Shared Books/Web transfer lock; native DocumentImporter performs library writes, not the worker.
Exact source URL plus native library wrapper used to match import; uncertain imports require checking My files before retrying.
Completed/cancelled/error staging cleaned; own interrupted jobs pruned after one week on a later download.
Headers-only binary detection keeps the pre-existing deferred Qt.callLater abort, avoiding abort inside HEADERS_RECEIVED. Unit regression asserts callback has exited and responseText is never read.
Books default validator limits and compiled ARM worker are unchanged; shared source only gains configurable default constants.

hardware.method: Real uinput/evdev taps: link, Cancel, link again, Save to My files, Back to Web and unsupported ZIP.

hardware.cleanup: Original Books/Dots/SSH/RSS/Web/Terminal/Update/E2E groups matched backups. Physical event2 restored to 13:66, own touch daemon removed, failure-service mask restored, xochitl active. No staging files left. Installed QML/resource archive/worker hashes match canonical source.

limitations: PDF/EPUB only; IPv6-only servers, nonstandard ports, plain HTTP and browser-cookie/login-only downloads are unsupported. Native import depends on firmware. Real hardware import tested with a direct PDF URL; extensionless binary-header handling and EPUB structure are covered by automated regressions, with native EPUB import separately verified in Books.
release_safety: Published 3.0.1 ZIP and source archive hashes unchanged. No website deploy, counter changes, signed-feed changes, commits or staging of unrelated work.
